parts.description: A sleek black writing pen with silver metallic accents, a textured knurled grip, and a metallic pocket clip. The main body features a smooth matte finish while the tip and clip are brushed metal.
parts.reasoning: The physical properties are estimated based on a high-quality pen construction, which typically involves dense ABS plastic or lightweight aluminum for the barrel, and steel or aluminum for the clip and tip. The mass is estimated at 20 grams (0.02 kg), which is standard for a premium pen of these dimensions (extents: 0.01m x 0.013m x 0.14m). Continuous Collision Detection (CCD) is enabled and highly recommended globally for this object, as its narrow diameter (~1 cm) makes it highly susceptible to tunneling through collision geometry at moderate to high velocities. Convex decomposition is selected for the collider type to accurately preserve the geometry of the pocket clip and the tapered tip, preventing the object from endlessly rolling as it would with a simple convex hull or cylinder approximation. The friction coefficients are tuned for smooth hard plastic/metal against typical desk surfaces.
